$comment: Runnable models the router cannot map onto the model registry, matched by hand for the model sheet only (modelSheet.ts). Not read by routing. relation: same = the model Artificial Analysis measured; same-model-faster-serving = that model on faster serving (scores apply, speed does not); nearest-sibling = a related model, shown as a note and never used for scores; none = nothing comparable.
